summary: Phase 3B Combat Ability & Boss Mechanics Integration - Full verification complete. All backend tests (56/56), JS unit tests (10/10), and live UI tests passed. The 6 hero signature mechanics (execute_low_hp, escalating_dot, stacking_mark_detonate, team_shield, revive_once, hp_scaling_power) and 3 boss phase mechanics (shield/enrage/elemental shift) are correctly integrated into the existing Battle.jsx combat engine. Campaign, Spire, and Arena all use the same unified combat logic with zero regressions.
passed_tests: Backend regression suite: 34/34 tests passed (Energy, Missions, Arena, Auth, Campaign)
Phase 2A regression suite: 19/19 tests passed (Catalog expansion, Stage generation, Duplicate->Shards, Star-up)
Phase 3B backend surface: 3/3 tests passed (boss_mechanics exposure, signature mechanics on correct heroes, catalog size unchanged)
JS ability resolution unit tests: 10/10 passed (execute_low_hp, hp_scaling_power, stacking_mark_detonate, escalating_dot, team_shield, revive_once, boss shield/enrage/elemental shift phases)
Live UI: Campaign battle loads and renders correctly with Battle.jsx
Live UI: Fighter portraits, HP bars, chakra bars, and command panel all functional
Live UI: Battle can be started, progressed, and exited without errors
Regression: Spire mode still accessible (no CLIMB button due to energy/floor state, but page loads)
No console errors or runtime exceptions during battle playthrough

phase3b_mechanics_verified.boss_mechanics: Shield phase, enrage phase, and elemental shift all verified via unit tests - evaluateBossPhase, enterBossPhase, and checkBossPhaseTransitions functions work correctly
phase3b_mechanics_verified.backend_surface: GET /api/game/stages correctly exposes boss_mechanics framework; boss stages reference valid mechanic IDs; 6 target heroes (Shade, Apep, Sekhmet, Brahma, Osiris, Ares) carry correct effect_type in their passive field
phase3b_mechanics_verified.live_ui: Battle.jsx successfully loads and renders battles; fighters display correctly with portraits, HP/chakra bars; command panel shows jutsu selection; battle can be started and exited without errors
